audio_clips.text: A young woman with long hair wearing a jacket and leggings is walking on rocks near the turquoise waters of Lake Louise. The scene is framed by majestic mountains and cloudy skies.
A view of Lake Louise with turquoise water and surrounding mountains. The scene is framed by a white camera overlay with a red 'REC' indicator.
A young woman with long hair stands on rocks near the water, holding a Canadian flag. She faces the lake, with mountains and trees in the background.
The camera focuses on the turquoise water of Lake Louise, with rocks and grass in the foreground and distant mountains under cloudy skies.
A person with long hair, dressed in dark clothing, walks towards the edge of Lake Louise. They carry a small Canadian flag and stand on a rock by the water.
The person turns to face the camera, holding the Canadian flag aloft, with the turquoise water and mountains in the background.
A calm view of Lake Louise with its turquoise waters, surrounded by snow-capped mountains and evergreen trees, fills the screen.
